item.title: Defense rests in Colts Neck murder trial; jury could begin deliberating soon
item.description: The defense rested on Tuesday afternoon, in one of the biggest New Jersey murder cases in years.

item.title: Tom Malinowski concedes to Analilia Mejia in NJ primary race
item.description: Tom Malinowski conceded the NJ-11 special Democratic primary election for Gov. Mikie Sherrill's former seat and congratulated Analilia Mejia on her upset win.

item.title: Super Bowl averages 124.9M viewers in US, Bad Bunny's halftime 128.2 million, both short of records
item.description: Sunday night's Super Bowl and Bad Bunny fell short of setting records for most watched U.S. broadcast and halftime show.

item.title: ICE chief defends his officers' actions before Congress after the deaths of 2 protesters
item.description: The head of Immigration and Customs Enforcement is defending his officers, saying they won't be intimidated while carrying out President Donald Trump's deportation agenda.

item.title: Dancing with the Stars Con brings ballroom magic to Palm Springs for the first fan convention
item.description: Dust off your dancing shoes! The first-ever Dancing with the Stars Con is coming to Palm Springs this summer. Featuring pros, judges and stars like Robert Irwin and JoJo Siwa, this three-day event is the ultimate fan experience. Tickets go on sale Feb. 14.

item.title: National Parks Service removes rainbow Pride flag from Stonewall National Monument
item.description: Local officials were quick to react and have vowed that New Yorkers will not stand for it: "They cannot erase our history."

item.title: Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning among Oscars Nominees Luncheon attendees
item.description: It's the most exclusive lunch in Hollywood! We're taking you inside the 2026 Oscars Nominees Luncheon with nominees like Kate Hudson, Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning and more. Watch "The Oscars" LIVE Sunday March 15 on ABC and Hulu.

item.title: AccuWeather: Brighter but windy
item.description: We'll finally make a run toward 40 degrees on Wednesday.

item.title: Nurses at all 3 NYC hospital systems involved in strike voting on ratifying tentative agreements
item.description: The union says nurses at all three hospital systems that remain on strike, including Montefiore, Mount Sinai and NewYork-Presbyterian, are voting on whether to ratify tentative agreements.

item.title: Man finishes handmade replica of NYC including all 5 boroughs after 21 years
item.description: A Queens-born artist started building a miniature replica of the city by hand and now 21 years later he has completed the work of art, which is on display at the Museum of the City of NY.
